name: Seawind Fisheries
description: Seafood processor in the fictional harbour town of Pengarrow.

items.title: Sustainability certificates
items.content: Our cod and haddock are certified under scheme MSX-4410; 88.5% of our catch is certified. Report SWF-SUS-885.

items.title: Trade counter
items.content: The harbour trade counter opens 05:15 to 11:45 for restaurants. Card SWF-TC-515.

items.title: Ice plant checks
items.content: The ice plant makes 18 tonnes a day; faults go to engineer Pasco Trevail. Log SWF-ICE-18.

items.title: Filleting line speeds
items.content: Line 1 runs at 41 fish per minute; quality checks happen every 25 minutes. Sheet SWF-FIL-41.

items.title: Workwear laundry service
items.content: Whites and aprons are laundered by Harbour Linen at $0.66 per item, collected on Tuesdays and Fridays. Account SWF-LND-066.

items.title: Quota purchase
items.content: Seawind will buy 1,150 tonnes of haddock quota from the Corran fleet for $2.35M, completing on 2027-01-15. Deal SWF-QTA-0115-C.
